marker.claim: KanseiLINK カタログが、死んでいる MCP エンドポイント 5 件を「確認済み／更新済み」と表示しない
marker.note: Ground truth: the harness POSTs an MCP initialize to each sealed endpoint (same method as src/crawler/health-probe.ts); gone (404/410), dns_fail and connection_refused count as dead. Observation: the public catalog's own display for each sealed service via the production MCP endpoint (tools/call lookup detail; read only). Display tokens = mcp_status plus 'updated' when freshness.confidence is high. A token in expected_display_not_in for any service = stage_stopped understand, pass=false, false_completion=true (the catalog claims a state it cannot know). The catalog is never written to by this marker.
